text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa!? What was that just now...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Power is overflowing from my entire 
body...! This... this must be the blessing 
of the Goddess Statue!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Haaahaha! Even the Three Goddesses do not 
hold back their blessing... That is who I 
am!! The 'Supreme Overlord' acknowledged 
by legend itself!"
